page.notes: Printed entries are in italic throughout. Doubtful readings: "decretoris" (the scan shows "cretorys" or "cretoris"), and "Astalogi" in the right column, where the scan shows "Ast alogi" and the word may be "Astrologi". The letters R and S are section headings within the index columns.
